AN ACT to authorize the assessor of the county of Nassau to accept a
retroactive application for exemption from real property taxes from the First
Reformed Church of Jamaica
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S2435

SPONSOR: THOMAS
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to authorize the assessor of the county of Nassau to accept a
retroactive application for exemption from real property taxes from the
First Reformed Church of Jamaica

 
PURPOSE:

To authorize the First Reformed Church of Jamaica, a not for profit
organization, to file an application for a real property tax exemption
all of the 2015-16, 2016-17 and 2017-18 school taxes, and all of the
2015, 2016, 2017 and 2018 general taxes since taking possession of the
property in April 2014.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 of the bill allows the First Reformed Church of Jamaica to
file a retroactive application for real property tax assessment for all
of the 2014-15, 2015-16, 2016-17 and 2017-18 school taxes, and all of
the 2015, 2016, 2017 and 2018 general taxes for the parcel that such
church took possession of on April 29, 2014, located in the town of
Hempstead.

Section two provides an effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

The First Reformed Church of Jamaica is a not for profit which has
proudly served the queens/Long Island area for 315 years. While the
church is situated in Queens its parsonage is located in West Hempstead.
The parsonage has been granted a real property tax exemption for future
taxes, but requires legislation to have retroactive exemption status to
the date of purchase in 2014. This legislation is designed to provide
the county assessor with authorization to accept an application to make
such a real property tax exemption retroactive. Once accepted, the
application can then be reviewed as if it had been received on or before
the deadline for such rolls.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

Similar to S6808 of 2017.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None to the State.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
Immediately.

A.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S2435A

SPONSOR: THOMAS
 
TITLE OF BILL:  An act to authorize the assessor of the county of
Nassau to accept a retroactive application for exemption from real prop-
erty taxes from the First Reformed Church of Jamaica

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

To authorize the First Reformed Church of Jamaica, a not for profit
organization, to file an application for a real property tax exemption
for all of 2014-2015, 2015-2016, 2016-2017 and 2017-2018 school taxes,
and all of the 2015, 2016, 2017 and 2018 general taxes for the parcel
that such church took possession of on April 29, 2014.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section one authorizes the Nassau County Assessor to accept an applica-
tion from the First Reformed Church of Jamaica for exemption from real
property taxes pursuant to sections 420-a and 462 of the Real Property
Tax Law for all of 2014-2015, 2015-2016, 2016-2017 and 2017-2018 school
taxes, and all of the 2015, 2016, 2017 and 2018 general taxes for the
parcel that such church took possession of on April 29, 2014; located in
the town of Hempstead at 880 Ossipee Court, West Hempstead, otherwise
known as: section 35, block 650, lot 6.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

The First Reformed Church of Jamaica is a not for profit which has
proudly served the queens/Long Island area for 315 years. While the
church is situated in Queens its parsonage is located in West Hempstead.
The parsonage has been granted a real property tax exemption for future
taxes, but requires legislation to have retroactive exemption status to
the date of purchase in 2014. This legislation is designed to provide
the county assessor with authorization to accept an application to make
such a real property tax exemption retroactive. Once accepted, the
application can then be reviewed as if it had been received on or before
the taxable status dates established for such tax rolls.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

2017-2018: S6808- Passed the Senate, delivered to Assembly/referred to
real property taxation.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS FOR STATE AND LOCAL GOVERNMENTS:

None to the state.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
Immediately.

summary: Authorizes the county of Nassau to accept an application for retroactive real property tax exemption from the First Reformed Church of Jamaica for a certain parcel in Hempstead.
